Hi, hope all is well. I wanted to give you an update in regards to recent issues with backup IG’s and posting. Recently there’s been a complete change in Instagram’s guidelines, as well as updated AI systems scans that remove content and add restrictions. They haven’t been very clear on how to properly get around this, so we have had pages constantly flagged, shadowbanned or deleted. We have been working nonstop to find a solution and as of last week, we have a working solution that it will last long-term. Unfortunately, the devices and software that we used before to run our accounts won’t work anymore, and we had to invest over $40,000 into a new Phone Farm to be able to handle all of our clients with the proper quality needed. We are waiting for a shipment that should land Monday that will be the final piece needed to begin and scale. From what I’ve tested and seen at a smaller scale, this new process will allow us to have almost no issues, and we will be able to grow your accounts and protect your main accounts properly moving forward. As for the models that allow us to use the main pages, if you noticed that we may have paused in the last week or so, it is due to us, making sure your accounts are completely secure and are not at risk, as we know how important they are. My apologies, for any lack of communication. As this has required us to swap out over 200 devices, and over 1000 accounts. We also we’ve introduced a meta support team, that is able to help you regarding any issues with your account. Majority of issues will be covered in house, and any that will need a higher up rep, we will split that cost with you, if it’s something you want! I’m extremely excited for this to roll out, as just the testing alone in two weeks has generated over 400 million views across the Accounts. Thank you for your understanding, we will have plenty of updates starting next week.
